# v1.1.0-dev.120: The slimming release

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.119`.

Three features came out by choice, one long-standing bug got fixed, and
the companion-software crash in dev.119 is repaired.

## Fixed first: companion detection

dev.119 shipped a crash in the Companion software tab ("Detection
failed: scanFailed is not defined"). Detection runs clean again, and a
failed hardware probe now reports "unknown" instead of a confident "not
installed".

## Start with Windows works

The Run entry was written perfectly and Windows never launched it. On
current Windows 11 builds a Run entry with no record under
StartupApproved is silently ignored, so WLM now writes its own enabled
record, and never over one Task Manager has switched off.

## Removed: automatic activation

Profiles no longer load by themselves when the display configuration
changes, when an app starts, or on a hotkey. The chooser dialog, the
best-guess and manual remap flows, learned monitor sets and monitor-set
binding are gone with them. A Load places your windows onto whatever
monitors are current using each window's saved monitor role, exactly as
an unbound profile always worked. Set a hotkey on the profiles you care
about, or use the tray.

## Removed: Hold mode

The continuous keep-this-layout enforcement, its poller, the red border
and the per-window rollback trail are gone. Loading a profile remains a
single pass that puts every matched window back and reports the rest.

## Removed: zoom-to-resolution rules

The machine-wide mapping table is gone from Settings. A profile's own
display step (zoom, resolution, refresh, orientation, arrangement) is
unchanged.

## Also out

The window editor's "When this profile loads" section, and the "When
WLM closes" and "When an app loads, by app" lists from Settings. The
start-mode choice and the per-app Default and Close checkboxes live on
the Virtual Windows page's member rows, and stored choices are
untouched: editing a window no longer touches how it starts.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
